note: Tests 8 to 11 are cases of one parametrized test; each writes a small invalid file to a temporary directory and expects a ConfigError with the given message.

test_the_first_catalogues_are_configured.asserts: There are 22 entries; 10 are Service Catalogues; there are 13 distinct nodes.
test_the_first_catalogues_are_configured.why: Any entry added or removed by mistake shows up as a failing count.

test_ids_are_unique_and_nodes_are_known.asserts: No id appears twice, and every node is one of the 16 node ids of eosc-basic-compliance.
test_ids_are_unique_and_nodes_are_known.why: Results from the two projects can be joined by node.

test_type_and_protocol_agree.asserts: Each entry's protocol is the one its type requires.
test_type_and_protocol_agree.why: A Service Catalogue is never probed with OAI-PMH, and the reverse.

test_endpoints_are_https_and_oai_bases_h.asserts: Every endpoint starts with https://; no OAI-PMH endpoint contains verb=.
test_endpoints_are_https_and_oai_bases_h.why: The probe adds ?verb=Identify itself; a copied request URL would break it.

test_every_entry_comes_from_the_producti.asserts: source is resource-hub for Poland and production for every other node. listed holds only comment and evaluation_eosc_a.
test_every_entry_comes_from_the_producti.why: Provenance stays explicit; only the production sheet's two columns are quoted.

test_resource_hub_entries_quote_nothing_.asserts: There are exactly 3 Resource Hub entries. None has listed, and each note cites a "Hub record 21.11166/…" PID.
test_resource_hub_entries_quote_nothing_.why: The Hub has no comment column, so nothing is attributed to it, and each entry can be traced.

test_a_display_endpoint_is_explained_in_.asserts: Only eosc-cz-nmd-oai has a display_endpoint. It differs from endpoint, and both URLs appear in the note.
test_a_display_endpoint_is_explained_in_.why: Showing one URL while querying another is always disclosed.

test_bad_entries_are_rejected[queried wi.asserts: A Service Catalogue declared with oai-pmh is rejected.
test_bad_entries_are_rejected[queried wi.why: Checks the type/protocol rule in config.load().

test_bad_entries_are_rejected[unknown ty.asserts: A type such as dataset-catalogue is rejected.
test_bad_entries_are_rejected[unknown ty.why: Only the two catalogue types exist.

test_bad_entries_are_rejected[without ?v.asserts: An OAI-PMH endpoint ending in ?verb=Identify is rejected.

test_duplicate_ids_are_rejected.asserts: Two entries with the same id are rejected.
test_duplicate_ids_are_rejected.why: Ids are keys on the page and in the JSON.

test_unknown_listed_fields_are_rejected.why: Quotes are limited to the two production-sheet columns; for example, the sheet's status is not carried over.

test_every_known_node_has_a_display_name.asserts: NODE_NAMES in report.py covers exactly the 16 known nodes.
test_every_known_node_has_a_display_name.why: Every card can show a readable node name.

test_version.asserts: catalogue-check version exits 0 and prints the package version.
test_version.why: The command-line tool installs and starts.

test_catalogues_lists_the_configured_one.asserts: catalogue-check catalogues exits 0, lists bbmri-eric-services, and ends with "22 catalogue(s): 10 service, 12 research product."
test_catalogues_lists_the_configured_one.why: The listing command reads the committed file and counts it correctly.

test_an_empty_list_is_reported.asserts: An empty catalogues: [] file prints "No catalogues configured yet." and exits 0.
test_an_empty_list_is_reported.why: An empty file is reported, not treated as an error.

test_a_bad_file_is_a_configuration_error.asserts: An entry with only an id makes the command exit with status 2.
test_a_bad_file_is_a_configuration_error.why: A malformed file stops the tool with a distinct exit code.

test_report_without_probe_writes_per_cat.asserts: catalogue-check report --no-probe writes JSON with 22 catalogues. Each has a node name, no probe result, and all its configuration checks passing.
test_report_without_probe_writes_per_cat.why: The results page's data file is built correctly, without using the network.
